confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Amalfi Coast resort pricing in peak July season; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant anchors (meals, wine) are moderately reliable. Accommodation (especially dorm and 1-star) and cocktail prices are less certain because July rates vary widely by date and availability. Drink anchors are based on general Italian coastal price levels rather than local menus.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on peak-season pricing in Sorrento-peninsula and Amalfi Coast resort towns (such as Positano and Amalfi), set below Capri-level luxury pricing and above typical Naples pricing. Anchors reflect ordinary local venues and registered accommodation.
